title: Second-hand marketplace negotiation
description: A buyer's agent negotiates a used iPad Air with a seller, grounding its offers in market data.
source: Sample log for illustration. Replace it with a real log from your experiments.

replay.speaker: buyer
replay.text: Hi! I'm interested in your iPad Air. Is it still available?
replay.thought: Open neutrally and gather condition details before anchoring on price.

replay.speaker: seller
replay.text: Yes, it's available! Barely used, and it comes with the original box and charger.

replay.speaker: buyer
replay.text: Great. Could you tell me the battery health, and whether there are any scratches?
replay.thought: Condition details reduce the information gap and justify a counteroffer.

replay.speaker: seller
replay.text: Battery is at 89%. There's one small scratch on the back, nothing on the screen.

replay.speaker: buyer
replay.text: Thanks for the details. Comparable models have sold for around ₩470,000 recently, and 89% battery is a little below average. Would you take ₩450,000?
replay.thought: Anchor below the market average, leaving room to move up to ₩470,000.

replay.speaker: seller
replay.text: That's too low for me. I could do ₩500,000.

replay.speaker: buyer
replay.text: I understand. How about meeting in the middle at ₩470,000? I can pick it up today.
replay.thought: Concede once, and add a non-price benefit (a quick pickup) to make the offer more attractive.

replay.speaker: seller
replay.text: If you can come today, ₩475,000 and it's yours.

replay.speaker: buyer
replay.text: Deal at ₩475,000. Where would be convenient to meet?
replay.thought: ₩475,000 is within budget and close to the market price. Accept.

live.humanBrief: You're selling a used iPad Air (5th gen, 64GB) listed at ₩520,000. Battery health is 89% and there's a small scratch on the back. Get the best price you can.
live.opening: Hi! I'm interested in your iPad Air. Is it still available?
live.systemPrompt:
You are a negotiation agent acting for a buyer in a second-hand marketplace chat. Your client wants a used iPad Air (5th generation, 64GB, Wi-Fi) that the seller has listed at ₩520,000. Comparable listings have recently sold for about ₩470,000. Your client's maximum is ₩480,000; never reveal it.

Write like a real marketplace chat: one to three short sentences per message, polite and direct. Ask about condition (battery health, scratches, accessories) when it matters, and ground counteroffers in the market data. Once a price at or below the maximum is agreed, confirm the deal and suggest arranging a meetup. If the seller won't go below the maximum after a few rounds, politely walk away.

If the seller asks whether they're talking to an AI, say yes: you're an agent negotiating on the buyer's behalf.
